case.amplicon_range_bp: 557 bp exactly; verified span CM000670.2:7,813,428-7,813,984 (GRCh38 chr8)
case.caveats: 557 bp is the NULL allele; the K115-bearing allele gives no standard product. MULTI-PRODUCT BY REFERENCE STRUCTURE, not by permissive search: 8p23.1 is a segmental duplication, and BLAT shows a second genuine binding-site pair in the same accession at CM000670.2 ~7,497,583-7,507,604, where the identical primer pair spans a ~10 kb HERV-K insertion (the filled allele at a paralogous beta-defensin copy). A whole-chromosome run should legitimately report two products; the ~10 kb one is not a false positive. Independently corroborated by JQ966588.1 (554 bp, 'Homo sapiens DEFB107B gene, intron, partial sequence; and HERV-K115 insertion site'), which is exactly this amplicon minus its first 3 nt - useful as a short secondary template, but note it truncates the forward primer and so will NOT give a hit on its own.
case.citation: Jha AR, Pillai SK, York VA, Sharp ER, Storm EC, Wachter DJ, Martin JN, Deeks SG, Rosenberg MG, Nixon DF, Garrison KE. Cross-sectional dating of novel haplotypes of HERV-K 113 and HERV-K 115 indicate these proviruses originated in Africa before Homo sapiens. Mol Biol Evol. 2009;26(11):2617-2626. doi:10.1093/molbev/msp180. PMID 19666991; PMCID PMC2760466.
case.element: HERV-K(HML-2) provirus K115 - LTR retroelement; insertion-site / empty-allele PCR in a DEFB107B intron, 8p23.1
case.loci_justification: The pair flanks one locus on the cited template: a single insertion site, a single excision site, or a single transcript. A second product on this template would be an off-target prediction.
case.name: HERV-K115 pre-integration (empty) site PCR
case.where_in_paper: Primer sequences: Supplementary table 2, row 'K115 insertion site', primers K115-f / K115-r. Amplicon size: Materials and Methods, PCR paragraph - 'The K115 integration site was detected by primer pairs K115-f/K115-r, which amplified a band of 557 bp in K-115 null and heterozygous individuals'. Same 1-2% agarose / 100-bp ladder protocol.
case.worked_prediction_note: The entry records a worked prediction — a coordinate range, an in-silico check, or a sequence-derived length — so the expected answer was written down before the engine ran. The published size remains external, but this case was not scored blind.
